summary: Access Control System Testing Complete - All 21 backend tests passed. All 4 frontend UI tests passed. Fixed bug: HRMS dashboard endpoint was missing require_hrms_access middleware, allowing sales_executive to access HRMS dashboard stats.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login with hr@k3gas.com returns role=hr_admin, allowed_dashboards=['hrms']
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with employee@k3gas.com returns role=hrms_employee, allowed_dashboards=['hrms']
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with admin@k3gas.com returns role=admin, allowed_dashboards=['inventory','hrms']
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with sales@k3gas.com returns role=sales_executive, allowed_dashboards=['inventory']
Backend: GET /api/auth/me returns allowed_dashboards and linked_employee_id for each role
Backend: Admin can access HRMS dashboard stats
Backend: HR Admin can access HRMS dashboard stats
Backend: Employee can access HRMS dashboard stats
Backend: Sales Executive correctly denied HRMS access (403)
Backend: Employee attendance GET only returns their own records (linked_employee_id restriction)
Backend: HR Admin can see all attendance records
Backend: POST /api/users with role=hr_admin creates HR Admin user with allowed_dashboards=['hrms']
Backend: POST /api/users with role=hrms_employee + linked_employee_id creates Employee user
Backend: HRMS Dashboard loads for admin
Backend: HRMS Dashboard loads for hr_admin
Backend: HRMS Dashboard loads for employee
Backend: Admin can access Inventory dashboard
Backend: Admin can access HRMS dashboard
Frontend: HR Admin login auto-redirects to /hrms (skips dashboard selector)
Frontend: HR Admin sidebar shows all HRMS nav items, no Switch to Inventory button
Frontend: Employee login auto-redirects to /hrms
Frontend: Employee sidebar shows only Dashboard, Attendance, Payroll (hides Employees, Departments, Performance, Hire Analytics, Company Settings)
Frontend: Admin login shows dashboard selector with both Inventory and HRMS options
Frontend: Admin HRMS sidebar shows Switch to Inventory button
Frontend: Sales Executive login auto-redirects to Inventory (no HRMS access)

bugs_fixed.issue: HRMS dashboard stats endpoint was using get_current_user instead of require_hrms_access middleware
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed @router.get('/hrms/dashboard/stats') to use Depends(require_hrms_access) and added import for require_hrms_access
bugs_fixed.impact: Sales executives could previously access HRMS dashboard stats API, now correctly returns 403

critical_code_review_comments: Access control properly implemented in deps.py with require_hrms_access and require_hrms_admin middleware
Login and /me endpoints correctly return allowed_dashboards based on role
DashboardSelector.jsx correctly auto-redirects when user has only one allowed dashboard
HRMSLayout.jsx correctly filters navItems by item.roles array - items without roles array shown to all HRMS users
Employee attendance restriction working correctly via linked_employee_id in hrms_attendance.py
seed_data_creation: None - used existing users created by main agent
context_for_next_testing_agent: Access Control System fully tested and working. Key files: deps.py (require_hrms_access, require_hrms_admin), auth.py (login returns allowed_dashboards), hrms_attendance.py (employee restriction via linked_employee_id), AuthContext.js (canAccessHRMS, canAccessInventory), DashboardSelector.jsx (auto-redirect), HRMSLayout.jsx (role-based nav filtering). Bug fixed: hrms.py dashboard stats endpoint now uses require_hrms_access middleware.

auto_redirect.single_dashboard_roles: Auto-redirect to their only dashboard (skip selector)

verified_features.employee_attendance_restriction: Employee can only see own records via linked_employee_id
